summary: This directory provides low-level internal utilities for handling ZIP archives, focusing on reading entries, extracting content, comparing archive structures, and generating new ZIP streams.
responsibilities: Reading and parsing ZIP archive structures
Extracting specific files or entire archives from ZIPs
Comparing two ZIP archives to identify differences
Filtering and ignoring file discrepancies during comparison
Creating ZIP archive streams from file definitions
relationships: Comparison logic utilizes ignore rules to filter discrepancies between files found in archives.
The reading utilities provide the base data structures used by the comparison engine.
Extraction processes operate on zip entries to move file content to destination paths.
The generation of ZIP streams relies on transfer information to package files into an archive.
designDecisions: Uses stream-based processing for efficient handling of large archive data.
Encapsulates archive access logic to ensure proper resource lifecycle management.
Separates comparison, reading, and writing concerns into distinct modules.
Implements rule-based filtering to make archive comparison configurable.
